caption: The drawing shows a single ornate object depicted from two different perspectives on an off-white or beige background. The main object is an oval-shaped basket or bowl with a scalloped rim, featuring elaborate openwork designs made up of swirling, curved, and leaf-like motifs, all meticulously rendered in fine gray pencil or ink lines. The upper portion of the drawing presents the object in a three-dimensional, oblique view, highlighting the depth, curving contours, and filigree pattern. The lower portion of the drawing contains a flat, elevation view of the object's side, clearly displaying the repetitive, symmetrical scrollwork pattern and the scalloped edge of the rim. There is a short handwritten notation in the lower right corner of the drawing, and the object appears monochromatic, rendered entirely in shades of gray. The drawing is set within a rectangular border that is centered on the page.
title: Silver Wine Coasters
